name: Peter Woodsford
story: A later technical account by Geoff Howard, Robin Pickering, Dave Mole and Peter Woodsford records that Surveyor-General Bill Robertson approved a business case around 1987 to convert the 1:250,000 mapping into a digital database. The programme was expected to take about three years but was reported as completed in roughly eighteen months.
The 1999 account adds Dave Mole and Peter Woodsford during the move to Laser-Scan technology.
